services.desc: Middle Tennessee Hot Air Adventures, LLC is the premier hot air balloon ride business in Tennessee. We also support and attend many local hot air balloon festivals in middle Tennessee. Below is a list of hot air balloon events which you can bring the family out and attend. You will also find links with all of the information you need to see hot air balloons up close. We are working on updating a complete list of festivals and balloon glows in the area for 2024 Here we are helping two passengers over 90 years old check off their bucket lists! About Us - Pricing - Book Now - FAQ's - Photos - Festivals - Gift Voucher - Contact - Crew

blurb: Middle Tennessee Hot Air Adventures offers hot air ballooning services in Nashville, Franklin, and surrounding areas. They fly over less developed areas, hollows, and hidden lakes, providing views of wildlife and rolling hills. The business is family owned and prioritizes passenger safety.
